domain_qualname.description: Interchange qualname of the BaseDomain owning this entity (for accent coloring).

entity_kind.description: Kind of the entity row; 'enum' marks a closed dictionary.

annotation.description: The field's full annotation, for the row's tooltip; null from a service on an older aoa-action-machine (spec 029).

field_id.description: Interchange node id of the EntityField vertex when the row is a scalar field (null for synthetic relation/FK rows).

reference_qualname.description: Interchange qualname of the closed dictionary this field references; null for a scalar field.

values.description: The values a closed dictionary declares, each one its reference object; empty for every other kind.

groups.description: One entry per specialization axis, drawn as a container around its alternatives. ERD-only: no other diagram reads this, and a member keeps its own node, columns and outside relations.

classifier_field.description: The head's field whose value selects among the members; null when a closed dictionary classifies the axis.

group_id.description: The axis's own identifier, `<head qualname>:<field name>`; the relation into the container points at it.

members.description: Qualified names of the alternative entities. At least two, because an axis with one alternative is a plain relation and is emitted as one.

source_field.description: The field on the source table that points at the target; written at the target's end.

target_field.description: Its declared inverse on the target table, or null; written at the source's end.

properties.description: Every line between two tables of the whole request (the union of its slices); the merged multi-domain ERD draws these, pruned to the tables on screen.

source_field.description: The field on the source table that points at the target; written at the target's end.

target_field.description: Its declared inverse on the target table, or null; written at the source's end.
